GUI.note:
Assessment
Soraya Kihn is a 65-year-old female (DOB 1958-12-19, MRN SYN-7953087) referred for evaluation of chronic watery, non-bloody diarrhea of 10 weeks duration (6-8 stools/day including 2 nocturnal stools, urgency, one episode of incontinence, and 3 kg weight loss; no abdominal pain). Prior screening colonoscopy in 2016 was normal without biopsies. Prior laboratory and stool evaluation showed negative infectious studies (C. difficile toxin PCR, GI pathogen PCR panel, O&P, Giardia antigen), negative celiac serology (tTG-IgA 1.1 U/mL with normal total IgA 238 mg/dL), normal TSH (2.0 mIU/L), normal CRP (0.6 mg/dL), normal hemoglobin (13.1 g/dL), potassium (3.6 mmol/L), and albumin (4.0 g/dL), and a mildly elevated fecal calprotectin (132 ug/g).

Differential Diagnosis & Confirmation:
1.
